title: Collector XP and crafting updates
changes: Collecting from full or partial Flora Collectors grants Foraging XP per item, just like picking. Selected professions earn 100% skill XP; unselected professions earn 50%.
Fix cart-sign initialization with CraftyCarts and BoardersBumperBlurbs.

Include levels and experience mappings for 60 previously uncovered creatures. Meadows skeletons use level 8 and wild Black Forest roots use level 15; summoned companions and offspring grant no kill XP.
Update AzuCraftyBoxes to 1.8.24 and FirstPersonMode to 1.4.4.
Retain the farming XP, manual honey collection, profession-level retention, and crop-balance fixes from the preceding releases.
